.@SteveScalise is a fighter and cancer doesn’t stand a chance against him. 

Please join Leslie and I in praying for his strength, a quick recovery, and peace for his family as he begins treatment.

I sent a letter to @SecBecerra expressing concern over the lack of effort to address TBI and advocating for HHS to establish a National Traumatic Brain Injury Task Force to transform the treatment and care of TBI patients.

Read the letter here ⬇️ https://t.co/hJOgwvOQ1S

Last night we passed the FY24 DOD Appropriations Act that includes my amendment to fund clinical research into new treatment options desperately needed by our service members & veterans.

More details ➡️ https://t.co/8SrexdJNLH https://t.co/csIonTIYNj

Our veterans are ready for an innovative, nonaddictive treatment for PTSD, TBI, and other combat-related injuries. Psychedelic therapy is just that, and I hope to see the VA leading on it. https://t.co/LGDDDsMhp0

This National Salute to Veteran Patients Week, I’m proud to be a member of @bipartisanvets. As veterans, making sure the VA gets it right is personal. Our brothers and sisters in arms use VA programs. We will continue to prioritize the health of our veterans, this and every week. https://t.co/dpINRb8Iuv

April is Cancer Prevention and Early Detection Month! Routine screenings can mean better outcomes for your health—that means more treatment options, more healthy days ahead and more time with the people you love. Learn more: https://t.co/11x1rK86xx

I had a great time at PHI Air Medical Base today, especially since I was able to have my two favorite constituents with me! 

In addition to emergencies, PHI Medical flies into areas that are unreachable due to floods or accidents. Thankful for the lifesaving work these men and women do!

This was a poor decision & a step in the wrong direction.

I'll never stop advocating for innovative solutions for our veterans and service members.
https://t.co/aBvRuIDwyB

“The Dutch government should allow treatment with ecstasy chemical MDMA for people with PTSD, an advisory body set up to look at the issue has recommended.”

Comes after an FDA panel rejected approval for the same treatment in the U.S.

Wow.
https://t.co/uDaiaoPU3C

These therapies, as a multitude of trials have shown, provide a lifeline for countless individuals for whom conventional therapies have proven insufficient.
https://t.co/mCZR8eCYrg

@US_FDA will decide on August 11th whether to approve MDMA-assisted therapy for PTSD. 

This could be the first new PTSD treatment in 25 years. 

Tune into the press conference livestream at NOW as we discuss  why this will save veterans’ lives.
https://t.co/UhtkCTQFW5

I will never stop advocating for innovative solutions for our veterans and service members who are battling PTS, PTSD, TBI, and other combat-related mental health injuries. 
https://t.co/5AL6LCaaSr
I am deeply disappointed by the FDA's decision to reject MDMA as a treatment for PTSD. (1/4)

For many veterans, myself included, psychedelic treatment has shown life-changing results in treating combat-related mental health injuries, especially where conventional treatments, like opioids, have fallen short. (2/4)

This decision is major setback for those who are desperately seeking and deserve effective treatment options. However, I remain committed to advancing legislation that supports innovative therapies for PTSD. (3/4)

Thank you to everyone who joined our Veterans Town Hall yesterday. 

Whether it's healthcare, employment, education, or other concerns, your input is crucial as we work to ensure that all veterans receive the care and support they deserve. https://t.co/mMVtvyCeu5

As a veteran, #VeteranSuicidePreventionDay hits close to home. Too many of my brothers & sisters in arms have struggled in silence.

I’ll always work to ensure they have the mental health resources & support they need. 

No one who fought for our freedom should ever feel alone.

The DEA's push for increased production of psychedelics for research signals a critical step in understanding their potential benefits to treat combat-related mental health injuries. 
https://t.co/E7KoIy2mFi

Proud to introduce the Specialist Joey Lenz Act, which addresses the critical need for comprehensive and preventive health evaluations to support the health and readiness of the U.S. Armed Forces. https://t.co/ASZMFEnkyw

The Senator Elizabeth Dole 21st Century Veterans Healthcare and Benefits Improvement Act delivers:  

✅ Expanded high-tech career programs  
✅ Access to at-home care for aging vets  
✅ Faster, better community care  

We’re building a VA that works for our veterans 🇺🇸

My legislation, the Modernization of VA Disability Benefits Questionnaires Act, is included in the Senator Elizabeth Dole 21st Century Veterans Healthcare and Benefits Improvement Act!

This will revolutionize the way veterans' disability claims are processed by:
💻 Updating outdated IT systems
📋 Standardizing disability exam reports
⚙️ Making reports machine-readable
The Senator Elizabeth Dole 21st Century Veterans Healthcare and Benefits Improvement Act PASSED ✅ https://t.co/HWWNAr2nVa

📣The House & Senate have passed the Elizabeth Dole 21st Century Veterans Healthcare & Benefits Improvement Act, which includes my Modernization of VA Disability Benefits Questionnaires Act that will revolutionize the way veterans' disability claims are processed! 

Next stop ➡️ President’s desk

I hope the @HouseVetAffairs Health hearing witness was correct today when she said the vet suicide numbers are coming down.

I look forward to seeing the results of VA’s studies for 2024 because one thing is certain — the VA cannot continue to see a rise in suicides. https://t.co/x97eiwrezS

As a veteran myself, I’ve made it a top priority to ensure our service members and veterans receive the benefits they’ve earned. 

This year, we passed legislation expanding mental health resources for veterans and streamlining access to care.
